landing.features.items.dataUseLink: Learn how we use Google data
bullets: For Google Sign-In, your unique account ID, verified email, and name are used only for authentication and secure account linking.
Calendar access is used only to create, update, or delete Devu appointments in your primary Google Calendar.
We do not bulk-read your existing calendar events, and client phone numbers and free-form appointment notes are never sent to Google.
Google user data is never used for advertising, sold, or used to train artificial intelligence models.

landing.faq.title: Everything to know before you subscribe.

landing.faq.items.question: What is Devu's main benefit?
landing.faq.items.answer: Devu treats appointment reminders as part of daily operations, not as a separate messaging tool. WhatsApp reminders, quick replies, the Today view, calendar, and client records work together, so your team can see who is coming, who cancelled, and which appointment needs action in one flow.

landing.faq.items.question: Which businesses is Devu designed for?
landing.faq.items.answer: Devu is designed for small and medium service businesses that work by appointment, including healthcare and care services, consulting, beauty, sports, therapy, education, and similar appointment-focused teams. It is especially useful for businesses that communicate through WhatsApp without needing a complex CRM or heavy management software.

landing.faq.items.question: Can Devu replace my current calendar or notes system?
landing.faq.items.answer: Devu simplifies your team's daily appointment flow in one place. The appointment calendar, client profile, notes, photos, alerts, and WhatsApp message status stay in the same context. On plans with Google Calendar, appointments can also be written to the connected calendar so practitioners can follow their schedule on their phones.

landing.faq.items.question: Is a card required for the 14-day trial?
landing.faq.items.answer: The trial starts through the subscription flow, and iyzico handles payment security. This lets you complete setup and test whether Devu fits your real daily workflow. If you cancel before the trial or current subscription period ends, it will not renew.

landing.faq.items.question: How does WhatsApp setup work?
landing.faq.items.answer: Devu uses Meta's Embedded Signup flow. Start the connection with Facebook in the dashboard, then choose your business account and phone number in Meta's secure window. Devu stores the required technical credentials securely on the server. Our WhatsApp Setup Guide explains every step.

landing.faq.items.question: Do I need a new phone number for WhatsApp?
landing.faq.items.answer: Usually, yes. For the smoothest setup, we recommend a new or released number dedicated to the WhatsApp Business Platform. It should not be active in WhatsApp or the WhatsApp Business app and must receive an SMS or call for verification. This keeps automated reminders reliable and separate from personal WhatsApp use.

landing.faq.items.question: Do clients need to use the Devu app?
landing.faq.items.answer: No. Clients do not sign in to Devu, download an app, or create an account. They receive reminders through WhatsApp and use quick replies to confirm or cancel an appointment. Your team sees those replies as appointment statuses inside Devu.

landing.faq.items.question: What do WhatsApp quick replies do?
landing.faq.items.answer: They give clients clear actions inside the reminder, such as 'I will attend' or 'Cancel'. When a client responds, Devu updates the appointment status and shows it in the appointment details. Your team can identify confirmed or at-risk appointments without reading messages one by one.

landing.faq.items.question: Who is the mobile app for?
landing.faq.items.answer: The mobile app is designed for assistants and practitioners who stay on the move during the day. Desktop makes setup and management easy, while mobile focuses on running daily operations quickly and flexibly. Clients never use either platform; they only receive and answer reminders through WhatsApp.

landing.faq.items.question: What is the difference between Basic and Premium?
landing.faq.items.answer: Basic supports up to 2 active practitioners and 1 venue. Both plans include access for up to 10 team members, excluding the owner. Premium additionally supports 6 active practitioners, 3 venues, Google Calendar sync, payment tracking, weekly calendar view, team notifications, and larger photo storage.

landing.faq.items.question: Is payment tracking required?
landing.faq.items.answer: No. Devu's core value is WhatsApp reminders and simple appointment operations. Payment tracking is an additional module you can use when it fits your workflow. Teams that do not need it can continue using Devu solely for appointments, clients, and WhatsApp operations.

landing.faq.items.question: How are data and WhatsApp access protected?
landing.faq.items.answer: WhatsApp connects through Meta's official Embedded Signup flow, and technical credentials are encrypted on Devu's server. Devu never stores your card details; iyzico handles the payment process. Client data, appointment records, and team access are isolated and managed by workspace.

landing.faq.items.question: Can I cancel whenever I want?
landing.faq.items.answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time. You will retain access until the current trial or paid period ends, and the subscription will not renew afterward.

landing.finalCta.title: Try it, cancel if it is not for you.
landing.finalCta.body: Start your 14-day free trial with card verification and test Devu in your real workflow. Cancel before the trial ends and you will not be charged.
